capture_contract.assumption: All aroma mass drained from the gas-line state is recovered in the combined A+B condensate.
capture_contract.measurement: The chemistry is measured on the combined MIX; only water/condensate volumes are recorded separately for A and B.
capture_contract.forbidden_interpretation: No parameter or result from this analysis estimates the physical condenser efficiency.

model_contract.assumed_complete_capture_equilibrium: Two formation yields, fixed Morakul/Mouret equilibrium loss and instantaneous complete A+B capture.
model_contract.assumed_complete_capture_line_reservoir: Baseline plus one mass-conserving line-holdup time constant; every drained unit is assigned to A+B.
model_contract.assumed_complete_capture_delayed_respons: Baseline plus a smooth post-pulse formation response; A+B capture remains fixed at one.
Post-pulse formation response and line holdup jointly, with complete A+B capture fixed by assumption.

validation_policy.selection_rule: Select the simplest complete-capture model passing both-compound condensate improvement, wine guardrail, run consistency, bound, convergence and mass-balance gates.

data_quality_policy.reason: Common six-analyte spike at 144 h; raw chromatogram and independent duplicate unavailable.

interpretation_limits.complete_capture: eta_AB=1 is imposed from the equipment design and is not measured by the available data.
interpretation_limits.condensate_closure: A condensate mismatch tests the joint production/partition/complete-capture contract but cannot identify which component is wrong.
interpretation_limits.activation_peak: Pulse time and temperature transition are confounded in protocol A; activation_peak_h is phenomenological.
interpretation_limits.line_reservoir: tau is physical line holdup only if independently compatible with residence-time engineering information.
interpretation_limits.external_validation: Leave-one-run-out is retrospective internal validation; all six runs informed model development.
